title: Archive: keep a note out of the Feed, where it is, and undo it like any change
steps: Open Old launch plan: a line at its top says it's archived (this Preview's sample archives it), with Unarchive.
Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K) and type launch: Old launch plan comes last, dimmed, "archived".
Open another note and press ⌘⇧E (Ctrl+Shift+E): the line appears, and a notice says Archived, with Undo. In Vim, :archive and :unarchive do the same.
Run Open archive from ⌘⇧P (or type archive in ⌘K): each archived note, with Unarchive.
On a phone (or a narrow window), open a note and run Archive this note from its tab's menu: the line fits the screen, and Unarchive is a tap.
